items.description: The US black Espresso Series 1 pairs a 58 mm portafilter with guided recipes, adjustable pressure and temperature, fast manufacturer-stated warm-up, and assisted milk texturing. Fellow listed it at $1,499.95 on October 14, 2026.
items.bestFor: A buyer who wants a guided first routine and later control over pressure and temperature
